summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Aquasavannah LandVault MVP. 28/28 backend pytest cases pass (after one test naming fix). All major frontend flows verified: landing, public verify, citizen dashboard with parcel create + evidence upload, validator attestation submission, surveyor plan upload, admin command centre with 13 layers, trust scoring (real non-100 sub-scores), and tab navigation. Stripe checkout returns a real session URL; Paystack init/verify is mocked and properly idempotent.

minor.issue: Response keys are total_parcels/verified_parcels/total_attestations/registered_surveyors instead of the spec-described parcels/verified/attestations/surveyors. Test accepts both; consider aliasing or updating the spec.

issues: Disclaimer at bottom contains the word 'ownership' which is intentional disclaimer text — flagged briefly during testing as a string-match false positive, NOT an actual data leak.

action_items: Optional: align /api/public/stats key naming with the documented spec (parcels/verified/attestations/surveyors) to avoid client-spec drift.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 1561-line file. Recommend modular refactor (auth, payments, admin, trust, jobs) once feature freeze hits — current size hurts maintainability.
_id is consistently excluded via projections (good). MongoDB writes use atomic $inc for credit deduction with a guard ({balance: {$gte: amount}}) — sound concurrency handling.
Idempotency: Paystack verify uses session_id as idempotency_key on credit_transactions and a credits_granted flag on payment_transactions — verified idempotent in tests.
RBAC enforced via require_role dependency — CITIZEN and SURVEYOR correctly receive 403 on /api/admin/*.
Public verify response correctly omits owner_id and owner email (verified).

Trust validation computes real sub-scores from DB counts (evidence integrity, attestation consensus, certificate coverage, job completion, audit coverage) — sub_scores observed at 55/57/52 on fresh seed, confirming no false 100s.
Job processor only handles 10 jobs per call — fine for manual admin trigger but a real cron/worker would be needed in production (current queue depth was ~30 PENDING during test).
All endpoints use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL on frontend; no hard-coded URLs detected.
test_credentials: No persisted credentials file in /app/memory/test_credentials.md (file/dir empty). Used dev-login endpoint POST /api/auth/dev-login with role={CITIZEN|COMMUNITY_VALIDATOR|SURVEYOR|ADMIN} which is documented in the review request. Demo emails: citizen.demo@landvault.test, validator.demo@landvault.test, surveyor.demo@landvault.test, admin.demo@landvault.test.
seed_data_creation: Created during testing: 1 new parcel via citizen UI (TEST UI Community), ~50 drain parcels via API to test 402 path, 1 evidence record, 1 validator attestation, 2 surveyor plan uploads. Seed user wallet now ~95 credits (was 250). To reset, delete citizen.demo@landvault.test user — backend will re-seed on next startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is reusable. Run: pytest backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Test data is prefixed TEST_. The CITIZEN demo wallet may be low (~95 credits) — adjust drain logic if running insufficient_credits test after multiple iterations, or re-seed by deleting citizen.demo@landvault.test from DB.
